question: Where’s the closest café on the way from Sea Life Aquarium, San Antonio, TX toward Spring Lake Glass-Bottom Boat Tour, San Marcos, TX?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Sea Life Aquarium%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%San Antonio%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%TX%' LIMIT 1 ), end_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Spring Lake Glass-Bottom Boat Tour%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%San Marcos%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%TX%' LIMIT 1 ), route_path AS ( SELECT ST_MakeLine(s.geometry, e.geometry) AS geom FROM start_point s, end_point e ), buffered_route AS ( SELECT ST_Buffer(rp.geom::geography, 1000) AS geom -- Buffer the route by 1000 meters FROM route_path rp ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_state, p.addr_city FROM pois p, start_point sp WHERE p.amenity = 'cafe' AND ST_Intersects(p.geometry::geography, (SELECT geom FROM buffered_route)::geography) ORDER BY ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, sp.geometry::geography) ASC LIMIT 1;
